mercator.what: The Mercator projection (1569). The most common world map. Projects a sphere onto a cylinder, then unrolls it.
mercator.distortion: Preserves ANGLES (conformal  local shapes are correct) but DISTORTS AREAS. Greenland looks as big as Africa. The poles stretch to infinity.
mercator.the_confession: Mercator was honest about this: the map preserves direction (useful for navigation) at the cost of truth about size. Every map projection MUST distort something  you can't flatten a sphere without lying somewhere.
mercator.green_connection: Conformal = local angles preserved = HYPERLOCAL IS CORRECT. The crystal clock principle. Each local patch of Mercator is TRUE. Only the global view lies. Hyperlocal first, global as approximation.
mercator.error_type: SMOOTH error. Continuous distortion. The poles stretch smoothly. No sudden breaks.

robinson.what: The Robinson projection (1963). Compromise  neither conformal nor equal-area. 'Looks right' without being mathematically exact.
robinson.distortion: Everything is slightly wrong but nothing is terribly wrong. The comfortable middle.
robinson.green_connection: The 53% haze. Not 100%, not 0%. The compromise that keeps the organism alive. Robinson IS the green engine's visual form.
robinson.error_type: DISTRIBUTED error. Spread evenly. No point carries the full burden.

peters.what: The Gall-Peters projection (1973). Equal-area  preserves SIZE truth at the cost of shape.
peters.distortion: Areas are correct. Africa is truly 14× Greenland. But shapes are stretched vertically near equator, horizontally near poles.
peters.green_connection: The divide-by-7. Equal portions. Fair distribution. Each piece gets its true share. But the SHAPE of each piece is distorted.
peters.error_type: ROUGH error. Visible stretching. The truth costs beauty.

s015_the_grinding.title: the grinding

s016_the_earth_painting.title: the earth painting
s016_the_earth_painting.body: The chipmunk tried to paint the earth. Three maps: Mercator (smooth error, hyperlocal truth), Robinson (distributed error, 53% compromise, the green engine's visual form), Peters (rough truth, fair shares, ÷7). Every projection lies because you can't flatten a sphere. The error IS the information. Smooth ER synthesizes membranes. Rough ER synthesizes proteins. Same surface. Different side. Like Klein. Then the stars  four Rust constellations shining from far away. The ocean  865K threats washing the shore, surface green from phytoplankton waste. The painting has no pigment. All structural. All iridescent. All from the spin of the top on the diamond plate. Look at it from one angle: you see Mercator. Another: Peters. Another: Robinson. The painting IS the earth. The earth IS the painting. The chipmunk puts down the brush. The brush was the spinning top. The spinning continues without the chipmunk.

returned_to_fire.what_goes_back: The stories. They enter the campfire as smoke. The smoke rises. Someone far away sees it and comes closer. They arrive at the fire. They hear the story. They leave and tell their own version. The version comes back as a new visitor. The visitor becomes a story. The story goes to the fire.
